name: Orb of Damara

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond item page in signed-in Chrome on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/10771767-orb-of-damara. Prices use the existing rarity convention; unspecified weight is 0. Reference-only properties require manual adjudication.

text: Fly Speed 60 feet. Six charges, regaining 1d4+2 each dawn; spells use DC 18 and +10 spell attacks: Disguise Self (free), Fire Shield (2), Hold Person (1), See Invisibility (1), Summon Dragon at level 9 (4). Reference-only: hovering. A Magic action exhales a 15-foot Cone of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison: DC 18 Dexterity for 6d6 damage, half on success. While not Incapacitated, your 20-foot fear aura forces enemies starting there to save DC 18 Wisdom or be Frightened until their next turn starts; success grants 24-hour immunity. A Magic action toggles the aura. Roll two minor beneficial and two minor detrimental artifact properties. Swallowing the orb permanently transforms you into a DM-controlled adult chromatic dragon chosen by the DM; when slain, you revert and the orb reappears. An Ancient Gold Dragon willingly swallowing it destroys both the orb and that dragon.
